criteria.criterion: The eyebrow line is styled per focx.style.brand-eyebrow (Geist Medium, brand-eyebrow size, uppercase with matching tracking).
criteria.evidence: apps/site/styles.css:47-52 .eyebrow { font-size: var(--text-brand-eyebrow) [12px, design/tokens/focx/tokens.json focx.text.brand-eyebrow]; font-weight: var(--weight-medium) [500 = Medium]; letter-spacing: var(--text-brand-eyebrow); text-transform: uppercase }. Font family Geist inherited from body (styles.css:32). Note: the design system publishes no discrete 'tracking' token for Brand/Eyebrow (design/tokens/focx/tokens.json has no such leaf) — the build reuses --text-brand-eyebrow for letter-spacing, an identical pattern already shipped in apps/connect/styles.css:49-54 (pre-existing, not introduced by this run). No live Figma access this run (no MCP tool available) to confirm the literal '12' in the style token's description ('Geist Medium 12/1, tracking 12') resolves to 12px vs. a percentage — flagging as an unresolved design-token ambiguity for Design to close with a discrete tracking token, not a confirmed defect in this run's build, since no raw value was invented and the established repo pattern was followed verbatim.

criteria.criterion: The wordmark 'Focx' is styled per focx.style.brand-hero-desktop (focx.font.display family with a system fallback stack, brand-hero size).
criteria.evidence: apps/site/styles.css:54-59 .wordmark { font-family: var(--font-display) [The Fox Tail], ui-serif, Georgia, serif; font-size: var(--text-brand-hero) [64px]; font-weight: var(--weight-regular) [400]; line-height: 0.98 }. Matches focx.style.brand-hero-desktop's published description 'The Fox Tail Regular 64/0.98' verbatim, with a serif system fallback stack since The Fox Tail is unhosted (per brief constraint).

criteria.criterion: The positioning line is styled per focx.style.ui-subheading (Geist Medium, subheading size).
criteria.evidence: apps/site/styles.css:61-65 .subheading { font-size: var(--text-subheading) [17px]; font-weight: var(--weight-medium) [500]; line-height: 1.35 }. Geist inherited from body. Matches 'Geist Medium 17/1.35' per focx.style.ui-subheading. The style's '-0.4' tracking is not implemented (no discrete tracking token exists to express it without a raw value, disclosed in 40-design-spec.json's notes); the written acceptance criterion only requires 'Geist Medium, subheading size' and does not ask for tracking, so this is not a failure against the criterion as written.

criteria.criterion: The page's background and text colors are drawn only from published focx color tokens, and the specific pairing chosen keeps the CTA button visibly legible (non-zero fill contrast against the page background).
criteria.evidence: apps/site/styles.css:31-35 body { background: var(--surface-1) [#f9f9f9]; color: var(--surface-inverse) [#050505] }. CTA: background var(--action-fill) [#050505] on the #f9f9f9 page background — clearly non-zero contrast (near-black button on near-white page), with button text var(--action-fill-text) [#fcfcfc] on the #050505 fill. All four values trace to design/tokens/focx/tokens.json (surface-1, surface-inverse, action-fill, action-fill-text); no raw hex/px literals found in apps/site/styles.css (confirmed independently via drift-check, see evidence/drift-check.txt).
